scope: FIT plus validation development only; no outer predictions, metrics, model selection or adapter training

representation.seizure: exact source seizure_channel_embedding, captured at CrossSeizureMILAggregator input and compared to ordinary source forward output
representation.R4: exact original classifier input, classifier replay tolerance 1e-6
representation.channel_alignment: canonical_channels name-to-index mapping in source dataset, verified against source masks; unavailable => skip persistence

oracle.direction: unit mean of unit inner-fold coefficients

contexts.SR_DIST: FIT valid seizure-channel PCA8; per-seizure mean/std/q25/q50/q75=40D; across-seizure mean/std=80D plus log1p(S), multi-seizure flag=82D
contexts.SR_PERSIST: when canonical alignment passes, within-seizure rankdata(method=average)/(n_valid+1); across seizure/channel rank summaries 80D plus pairwise Spearman summaries 40D, pair flag and log1p(S)=122D; one-seizure pair statistics zero
contexts.SR_COMBINED: SR_DIST concatenated SR_PERSIST when alignment passes

seizure_shuffle.method: within patient randomly reassign pooled valid seizure-channel embeddings to pseudo-seizures preserving seizure counts, deterministic numpy RNG seed=42+first_64_bits_SHA256(subject_id)
seizure_shuffle.combined_control: shuffled SR_DIST concatenated with unchanged true SR_PERSIST; never fabricate aligned shuffled persistence

predictors.D1: FIT R4 shared LogisticRegression(C=1,lbfgs,max_iter=2000,random_state=42), equal total patient mass and 0.5 EZ/0.5 NEZ within each patient
predictors.D2: Ridge(alpha=10,fit_intercept=True) context to full FIT oracle direction; unit output
predictors.D3: Ridge(alpha=10,fit_intercept=True) context to FIT r80 coefficients; unit(w_bar+B_r80 a_hat)

wrong_context: cyclic next of 13 validation patients for D2/D3, target R4 unchanged, no selection
association: FIT patient pairwise context Euclidean distance versus oracle-direction cosine, Spearman, 10k FIT-patient-ID cluster resamples, aggregate only
bootstrap: 10,000 target-patient-ID cluster resamples, seed42; 65 fold-by-patient cells from 47 unique IDs; paired metrics

identification_gate.D3_seizure_context: any predeclared SR_DIST/SR_PERSIST/SR_COMBINED with all conditions
identification_gate.SR_PERSIST_shuffled_control: unavailable by design; cannot satisfy ninth condition without a fabricated control

outer_policy: No outer loader, predictions, metrics, or historical outer result inspection. Disclose legacy monolithic cache materialization if unavoidable.
public_outputs: aggregate-only code, lock, CSV, JSON and report; private labels, representations, cell records, caches and checkpoints remain off Git
